title: Quiz: Parameters and Arguments
description: Check your understanding of Parameters and Arguments.

questions.question: Which of these is the correct way to write a comment in Assembly?
questions.explanation: In Assembly, ; marks a comment. Block comments use ; (line comments only).

questions.question: What is the difference between a parameter and an argument?
options: Parameters are placeholders; arguments are the real values passed
They are exactly the same thing
Parameters belong to callers, arguments to functions
questions.correctAnswer: Parameters are placeholders; arguments are the real values passed
questions.explanation: Parameters define the shape; arguments supply the data.

questions.question: True or False: The number of arguments passed must match the number of parameters in most languages.
Fill in the blank: multiply(${x}, ${y})  // x and y are ___
questions.explanation: Values passed at call time are arguments.

questions.question: In Assembly, what is the safest way to predict what a program outputs?
options: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.correctAnswer: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.explanation: Read top to bottom, track variable values, and note every output statement.
